summary: A Fairbanks woman was charged with five domestic violence counts, four of them assault when a child was present, and was arraigned the same day. Three people arrested by Fairbanks police on Oct. 21 - on charges of driving under the influence and, in two separate cases, second-degree criminal trespass - now have court files, and a man was charged with felony failure to stop for a police officer over an Oct. 14 incident. A Fairbanks man was arrested on a warrant in an existing fourth-degree assault case, and troopers reported seizing 25 grams of fentanyl in the investigation behind this week's Class A felony drug charge. The filing counts below are the court's own weekly report figures for Oct. 15 to Oct. 21; at least one Fairbanks case filed inside that window, 4FA-26-02137CR, does not appear in that report. The U.S. Attorney's press index for the District of Alaska could not be read, so no federal cases are included in this edition.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault charges: Debrah Sarah Erma Holmberg
body: Debrah Sarah Erma Holmberg was charged with fourth-degree assault, recklessly causing injury, and with four counts of assault when a child is present, each a Class A misdemeanor and each flagged in the court record as domestic violence. The offenses are recorded at Fairbanks on Oct. 22.
Case 4FA-26-02138CR. She was arraigned Oct. 22, a public defender was appointed, and a pre-trial conference is set for Dec. 10 with a trial week of Dec. 21.

entries.title: Felony drug charge: Rayann Marlisa Carroll
body: Rayann Marlisa Carroll, 35, of Fairbanks, was charged with second-degree misconduct involving a controlled substance, manufacture or delivery of a schedule IA substance, a Class A felony. The offense is recorded at Fairbanks on Oct. 20.

Troopers state that investigators identified a package shipped to a Fairbanks residence on Oct. 14, obtained a search warrant and found 25 grams of fentanyl, which they valued at about $25,000, and that she was contacted and arrested on Oct. 20 by the Fairbanks Areawide Narcotics Team and the Fairbanks Criminal Suppression Unit.
Case 4FA-26-02128CR. She was arraigned Oct. 21 and a preliminary hearing is set for Oct. 29.

entries.title: Court reports 44 new criminal cases at Fairbanks for Oct. 15-21
body: The Alaska Court System's weekly report of criminal cases filed lists 44 new cases at the Fairbanks court for Oct. 15 to Oct. 21 and two at Delta Junction, with none at Nenana or Healy. One of the Fairbanks cases carries a Class A felony drug charge.

The report lists no cases filed at Fairbanks on Monday, Oct. 19, when court offices were closed for the Alaska Day observance. It is the third consecutive weekly report whose window covers that day and lists nothing for it.
At least one Fairbanks case filed inside that window does not appear in the report: case 4FA-26-02137CR, filed Oct. 16.
